domain: synthetic loaded chunks x/z -1..1, y 0..127; initial all air metadata 0; opacity/emission from uu.q/uu.s; native lm.c() initializes height-map/direct sky
emission: excluded: viewer full-cube edit API does not reach an emissive transition
entry: fd.a(IIIII)Z block setter; fd.a(eb, bounds); fd.j(); st.a(fd)
light_layout: lm.f sky; lm.g block; lm.c(IIII)I combined max(sky-subtraction,block)

seed_schema.initial_sky_light: native lm.c() all-air profile: 0 at y=0, 15 at y=1..127; native.tsv state rows encode deviations
seed_schema.initialization: all nine chunks allocate zeroed block, metadata, sky-light, block-light and height-map arrays; call lm.c() for each, then drain fd.j() to quiescence; native.tsv domain/state/height rows encode defaults and all deviations
seed_schema.material_properties: native uu.q[id] opacity and uu.s[id] emission
seed_schema.native_tsv_encoding: one domain row per case; state rows encode every nondefault block/meta/block-light/sky cell; height rows encode every nondefault height cell; domain digest is the complete native initial state digest
seed_schema.old_id_override: for nonzero old ID, set only the target cell with metadata 0 and settle native light queue before initial digest and before-phase queries
seed_schema.provider: xa.a(0) with native e() initialization; seed 0; synthetic world key light-update
